review.brief_reason: The proposed expression factors the common factor x1*x3 out of exactly the first three terms via the distributive law (A*x1*x3 + B*x1*x3 + C*x1*x3 = x1*x3*(A+B+C)), which holds for all real values. All remaining terms, constants, functions, and variable references are verbatim identical to the original. Distribution over real multiplication introduces no domain change: all subexpressions (log(Abs(x4)+1), sqrt of Abs terms, denominators sin(...)^2+1 >= 1) are defined on the same real domain in both forms. Decimal fitted constants are preserved exactly, and variable-to-column identity (x1, x2, x3, x4) is unchanged.
